mentions.name: Lexilingo
mentions.description: A language learning web app for serious students and teachers, offering simple ways to assign interactive homework, practice reading and speaking, and create custom materials for less commonly taught ('rare-ish') languages.
mentions.problem: Practice materials and homework tools are scarce for less commonly taught ('rare-ish') languages.
mentions.audience: Serious language students and their teachers.
